## HP AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

HP is positioning AI PCs, endpoint security, and hybrid-work devices as productivity drivers for enterprise users.

## AI Product Launches
- AI PCs: New commercial PCs with local AI acceleration capabilities
- HP Wolf Security: Endpoint protection features for enterprise device fleets
- Poly collaboration devices: Meeting-room and hybrid-work productivity hardware

## Productivity Updates
- Device lifecycle services for provisioning, support, and refresh management
- Managed print analytics to optimize print usage and supplies cost
- Collaboration hardware for hybrid meetings and distributed teams

## Enterprise Features
- Fleet management: Support for large-scale deployment and device lifecycle programs
- Security: Firmware, endpoint, and device-level protection capabilities
- Services: Warranty, support, managed print, and device-as-a-service options
